```{r}
init_params <- function(input, hidden, output){
  weights_list = list()
  bias_list = list()
  layers = c(input, hidden, output)
  
  for(n in 1:(length(layers) - 1)){
    weights_list[[n]] = matrix(rnorm(layers[[n]]*layers[[n+1]], 0, 0.01), nrow = layers[[n+1]])
    bias_list[[n]] = matrix(rnorm(layers[[n+1]], 0, 0.01), nrow = layers[[n+1]])
  }
  
  return(list(weights_list, bias_list))
}
```

```{r}
relu <- function(x){
  if(x > 0){return(x)}
  else{return(0)}
}
relu <- Vectorize(relu)

relu_matrix <- function(M){
  return(apply(M, 2, relu))
}

relu_deriv <- function(x){
  return((x > 0)*1)
}

softmax <- function(x){
  return(exp(x)/sum(exp(x)))
}

softmax_matrix <- function(M){
  return(apply(M, 2, softmax))
}

sum_vector <- function(M, Y){
  sum_norm <- function(x, y = Y){return(x+y)}
  return(apply(M, 2, sum_norm))
}

one_hot <- function(Y){
  one_hot_Y <- model.matrix(~ 0 + factor(Y))
  return(one_hot_Y)
}

get_predictions <- function(A2) {
  return(apply(A2, 2, which.max))
}

get_accuracy <- function(predictions, Y) {
  return(mean(predictions == Y))
}
```

```{r}
forward_prop <- function(weights_list, bias_list, X){
  Z_list = list()
  A_list = list()
  
  Z_list[[1]] = (weights_list[[1]] %*% X) |> sum_vector(bias_list[[1]])
  A_list[[1]] = relu_matrix(Z_list[[1]])
  
  it = length(weights_list)
  
  if(it > 2){
    for(n in 2:(it - 1)){
      Z_list[[n]] = (weights_list[[n]] %*% A_list[[n-1]]) |> sum_vector(bias_list[[n]])
      A_list[[n]] = relu_matrix(Z_list[[n]])
    }
  }
  
  Z_list[[it]] = (weights_list[[it]] %*% A_list[[it - 1]]) |> sum_vector(bias_list[[it]])
  A_list[[it]] = softmax_matrix(Z_list[[it]])
  
  return(list(Z_list, A_list))
}
```

```{r}
backward_prop <- function(A_list, weights_list, X, Y){
  d_weights_list = list()
  d_bias_list = list()
  error_list = list()
  
  n = length(weights_list) 
  
  error_list[[n]] = get_predictions(A_list[[n]]) - (one_hot(Y) |> as.matrix() |> t()) 
  
  d_weights_list[[n]] = t(error_list[[n]]) %*% weights_list[[n]]
  d_bias_list[[n]] = colSums(error_list[[n]])
  
  print(dim(error_list[[n]]))
  print(dim(weights_list[[n]]))
  
  for(k in (n - 1):1){
    error_list[[k]] = (error_list[[k+1]] %*% t(weights_list[[k+1]])) * relu_deriv(bias_list[[k]])
      
    d_weights_list[[k]] = t(error_list[[k]]) %*% weights_list[[k]]
    d_bias_list[[k]] = colSums(error_list[[k]])
  }
  
  return(list(d_weights_list, d_bias_list))
}
```

```{r}
update_params <- function(weights_list, bias_list, d_weights_list, d_bias_list, alpha){
  m = length(weights_list)
  
  for(k in 1:m){
    weights_list[[k]] = weights_list[[k]] - (alpha * d_weights_list[[k]])
    bias_list[[k]] = bias_list[[k]] - (alpha * d_bias_list[[k]])
  }
  
  return(list(weights_list, bias_list))
}
```

```{r}
gradient_descent <- function(X, Y, hidden, alpha, iterations){
  input_size = nrow(X)
  output_size = length(unique(Y))
  weibias_list = init_params(input = input_size, hidden = hidden, output = output_size)
  weights_list = weibias_list[[1]]
  bias_list = weibias_list[[2]]
  
  for(i in 1:iterations){
    ZA_list = forward_prop(weights_list = weights_list, bias_list = bias_list, X = X)
    Z_list = ZA_list[[1]]
    A_list = ZA_list[[2]]
    d_weibias_list = backward_prop(A_list, weights_list, X, Y)
    d_weights_list = d_weibias_list[[1]]
    d_bias_list = d_weibias_list[[2]]
    weibias_list = update_params(weights_list, bias_list, d_weights_list, d_bias_list, alpha)
    weights_list = weibias_list[[1]]
    bias_list = weibias_list[[2]]

}
```
